none: PAS CAM-62B6C7: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Valentinian. AD364-378, (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 12 o'clock, weight is 2.1g, diameter is 17mm
